functions.description: Extract base structure: timestamp, source host, process/service, optional pid, and remaining message
Strip Hostd/Vpxa bracketed metadata: thread/component id, severity, component name, clean message
Extract vmkernel cpu/thread id and inline severity token
Extract user, source/destination IPs, ports and related scratch fields from auth/network related messages

conf.regex: /(?:User (?<__u1>[\w.-]+)@(?<__ip1>[0-9.:a-fA-F]+) logged in as (?<__login_as>\S+))|(?:User (?<__u2>\S+) logged out)|(?:Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<__u3>\S+) from (?<__ip2>[0-9.:a-fA-F]+) port (?<__port1>\d+) ssh2)|(?:Accepted (?<__authmethod>\S+) for (?<__u4>\S+) from (?<__ip3>[0-9.:a-fA-F]+) port (?<__port2>\d+) ssh2)|(?:Authentication failed for user (?<__u5>\S+) from (?<__ip4>[0-9.:a-fA-F]+))|(?:Account (?<__u6>\S+) locked out after (?<__attempts>\d+) failed login attempts from (?<__ip5>[0-9.:a-fA-F]+))|(?:User (?<__u7>\S+) attempted CIM operation (?<__cimop>\S+) on class (?<__cimclass>\S+), access denied)|(?:Failed to connect to host (?<__dstip1>[0-9.]+) on port (?<__dstport1>\d+), connection refused)|(?:Host (?<__affectedhost>\S+) disconnected from vCenter (?<__dstip2>[0-9.]+), reason: (?<__reason>.+))/

functions.description: Consolidate scratch fields into clean user/src_ip/dst_ip/dst_port fields, classify action, normalize severity and protocol

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('logged in') ? 'login_success' : message.includes('logged out') ? 'logout' : message.startsWith('Failed password') ? 'login_failure' : message.startsWith('Accepted') ? 'login_success' : message.startsWith('Authentication failed') ? 'login_failure' : (message.startsWith('Account') && message.includes('locked out')) ? 'account_locked' : message.includes('CIM operation') ? 'access_denied' : message.startsWith('Failed to connect') ? 'connection_failure' : message.includes('disconnected') ? 'disconnected' : message.includes('Task Created') ? 'task_created' : message.includes('Task Completed') ? 'task_completed' : message.includes('HostSync complete') ? 'sync_complete' : message.includes('Certificate') ? 'certificate_warning' : message.includes('NTP') ? 'ntp_alert' : (message.includes('Cmd') && message.includes('Failed')) ? 'storage_path_failure' : 'other'
